outcome: SARS-CoV-2 detection in placenta and neonatal samples
SARS-CoV-2 antibody presence in cord blood
cohort: 45 pregnant women diagnosed with SARS-CoV-2 infection
finding: Pregnancy outcomes in women diagnosed with COVID-19 during their pregnancy were favorable in most cases, with a low rate of vertical transmission, but preterm births and intrauterine growth restrictions were relatively frequent.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was possible in most cases.
